scope: exploratory matched continued training; not full paper reproduction
parent: REST same-seed precision_v2 ERM best actor+critic; papers same-seed completed ERM latest adapter+critic; fresh matched Adam for every arm
bank: REST historical frozen first K3; papers three lowest historical validation OOD objectives from six completed ERM/WDRO best checkpoints, same family
critic_inverse: reference = current greedy length / (1 + current critic prediction); detach before sampled update; no calibration, clipping, or test feedback; reject nonpositive denominator
paper_k3: task cost / minimum same-family teacher task cost - 1, in both search and sampled training; original uses fixed-scale task cost; objective and lambda scale change explicitly acknowledged
rho: historical degree10 q75, REST unrooted; papers rooted calibration; no retuning
selection: minimum true validation worst OOD mean, earliest tie including update0; true test reports best and final; no test selection
evaluation: REST historical cached exact validation/test references; paper fresh deterministic validation/test under this experiment namespace; 4 groups equally weighted
statistics: all 3 seed values, mean, paired differences and descriptive seed bootstrap 95% interval; no significant general-benefit claim from 3 seeds
precision: float32 networks, float64 physical evaluators, no TF32, deterministic torch, single CPU math thread
resource: up to 3 concurrent jobs on GPUs admitted with >=16GiB free and <=35 percent utilization across 3 samples; 20 percent memory cap per process
recovery: tmux controller, exclusive locks, atomic latest with actor critic Adam lambda RNG update and best state, checkpoint every8; completed jobs skipped
